_doc: All on-screen text. zh is set in Fusion Pixel (integer-scaled), en in IBM Plex Mono. {count} is filled from data/game.json.

hook1.zh: 你每天都在和 AI 说话
hook1.en: You talk to AI every day.

hook2.en: But you have never seen them.

multiply._doc: The number ({count}, from data/game.json) is the big counter; `unit` sits on its baseline to its right (one lockup: 「190 位 AI」); zh is the second line.

rarity.zh: 稀有度，取决于真实实力

together.zh: 和朋友一起冒险、对战、交换
together.en: Explore, battle and trade with friends.

cta._url: destination line under the CTA (a URL or 搜索「智灵口袋」); empty = not shown. Needs the owner's decision.

catch._doc: the game's own catch message (content/text/zh-CN/battle.json "caught"); {name} = the wild one's on-screen name
